args: TOKEN="${WEBANATOMY_MCP_TOKEN:-}"; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.webanatomy/webanatomy_mcp_token" ]; then TOKEN="$(cat "$HOME/.webanatomy/webanatomy_mcp_token")"; fi; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.codex/webanatomy_mcp_token" ]; then TOKEN="$(cat "$HOME/.codex/webanatomy_mcp_token")"; fi; exec npx -y mcp-remote https://www.webanatomy.ai/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --transport http-first --silent
